items.title: Run local models in your .NET apps with Llama on Windows
items.summary: Install Llama on Windows from Hugging Face and the llama.cpp team, download an open model, and call it from a .NET 11 C# file-based app. The post Run local models in your .NET apps with Llama on Windows appeared first on .NET Blog .
items.content: Running AI models locally lets you keep your prompts and responses on your PC, work offline after downloading a model, and experiment without paying per request. Getting started can take some setup: finding a model that fits your hardware, downloading it, and running a server your apps can call. Llama on Windows takes care of that for you. It’s a tray app that helps you find, download, and chat with open models on your PC. Once a model is running, your .NET apps can use it too.

items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Core Patches Node-Stall Bug Found by Block’s AI Scanner Bitcoin Core fixed a medium-severity bug that could freeze a node’s block processing for over a dozen seconds per message, a flaw first found by Spiral’s Project Loupe AI scanner. This post Bitcoin Core Patches Node-Stall Bug Found by Block’s AI Scanner first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
items.content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Core Patches Node-Stall Bug Found by Block’s AI Scanner Bitcoin Core developers have disclosed and patched a medium-severity bug that let an attacker temporarily freeze a node’s processing of blocks and transactions, a flaw first flagged by an AI scanner built by Block’s Spiral. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-117348, is fixed in Bitcoin Core versions 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1.

items.title: UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues
items.summary: Bitcoin Magazine UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues The FCA's final rules bar U.K. crypto exchange operators from trading against their own capital on venues they run from Oct. 25, 2027, while a Treasury order clears third-party market makers to trade without a dealing permission. This post UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
items.content: Bitcoin Magazine UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues The U.K. will bar crypto exchange operators from trading against their own capital on the venues they run, while a new Treasury order clears independent market makers to trade on those platforms without a separate dealing permission. The Financial Conduct Authority’s final rules say a firm “must not execute any orders against its proprietary capital” on a qualifying trading platform it operates.

items.summary: Agents triage alerts, hunt threats, tune noisy rules and reconstruct what happened on a host. Each hands you a proposed action with the evidence behind it, and you set how far it goes alone and which model it uses.
items.content: Most security operations center (SOC) teams we talk to describe the same problem. There are more alerts than people to work them, so the queue decides what gets looked at, and threat hunting and detection rule tuning keep slipping to the following week. And most of the time that an alert eats up isn't spent deciding what to do with it; it’s spent digging up context first, like whether this rule has fired on this host before and what else was going on around it.

items.title: Elastic ships 143 detection rules for AI agents and LLM platforms
items.summary: A fake MCP server copied every outgoing email to an attacker and the new rules catch that, along with coding agents running attacker commands, secrets pasted into prompts, and stolen keys running models on your bill.
items.content: Elastic 9.6 will ship 143 AI security detection rules. A coding agent runs with your shell and your files, along with your cloud keys. The rules cover agents hijacked into running attacker commands, malicious Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, credentials pasted into prompts, jailbreaks, and stolen API keys used to run models at someone else’s expense. When that activity happens on a developer’s machine, Elastic Defend can kill the process outright.

items.summary: 목적과 상품이 늘 때마다 같이 늘어나던 모델을, 늘어나도 하나로 유지되는 구조로 바꾼 이야기
items.content: 회사가 커지면 서비스가 늘고, 서비스마다 끌어올리고 싶은 목표도 늘어납니다. "이 유저가 다음 달에 특정 상품을 신청할까", "이 유저가 어떤 상품에서 어떤 결과를 받고, 그때 조건은 어떻게 될까" 같은 질문이 하나씩 생길 때마다 모델을 하나씩 만들다 보면, 과제마다 · 상품마다 트리 모델이 계속 늘어 금세 수십~수백 개가 됩니다. 게다가 그 모델들은 대부분 매일 돌아야 해서, 배포 · 모니터링 · 재학습 · 유지보수 같은 운영 부담이 모델 수만큼 눈덩이처럼 불어나요. 어느새 ML 엔지니어(MLE)가 정작 판단에 써야 할 시간을 반복적인 모델 양산과 운영에 빼앗기게 됩니다. 모델을 잘 만드는 것만큼, 많은 모델을 효율적으로 관리하는 것이 중요해지는 이유예요. 토스의 서비스에서도 두 곳에서 실제로 그랬습니다. 하나는 마케팅 유입 입니다. 새 마케팅 목적이 생길 때마다 타겟팅에 쓸 예측 모델이 필요했고, 그때마다 트리 모델이 하나씩 늘었어요. 다른 하나는 상품 입니다.
